# [NordVPN](https://go.nordvpn.net/yourcode) vs ExpressVPN in 2026

Choosing between NordVPN and ExpressVPN in 2026 has become a common dilemma for anyone serious about online privacy, streaming, and security. Both are premium VPN providers with massive global server networks, but they differ in speed, pricing, extra features, and overall value. In this detailed NordVPN vs ExpressVPN comparison, we break down everything you need to know so you can make the right choice.

---

## Why Compare These Two VPNs

NordVPN and ExpressVPN consistently rank at the top of most "best VPN" lists. They both offer strong encryption, no-logs policies, and apps for every major platform. However, their approaches to pricing, advanced features, and performance have diverged more in recent years. Understanding those differences helps you pick the VPN that actually fits your needs.

---

## Plans and Pricing

### NordVPN pricing structure

NordVPN has moved to a tiered subscription model with Standard, Plus, and Complete plans. The Standard plan covers core VPN functionality, while Plus adds a password manager and data breach scanner, and Complete includes encrypted cloud storage. Monthly plans cost more, but long-term deals often drop the price significantly — sometimes below $4/month for a two-year commitment.

### ExpressVPN pricing

ExpressVPN keeps things simpler with a single plan that includes all core VPN features. A monthly subscription is noticeably higher than NordVPN's entry-level option, but long-term plans bring the cost closer. ExpressVPN doesn't bundle extra tools like cloud storage or a password manager, so you're paying purely for the VPN service.

### Which offers better value

For budget-conscious users, NordVPN typically wins on price, especially with frequent discounts. ExpressVPN appeals to those who prefer a straightforward, no-frills premium VPN without tiered upsells.

---

## Server Network and Global Reach

### NordVPN server coverage

NordVPN operates a very large server network spread across many countries. The company uses RAM-only servers and has invested heavily in 10 Gbps server infrastructure. A higher server count generally means less congestion and more options for bypassing geo-restrictions.

### ExpressVPN server footprint

ExpressVPN maintains servers in a broad range of countries as well. While the total server count is lower than NordVPN's, the quality and consistency of the network are strong. ExpressVPN uses its own Lightway protocol, which contributes to fast connections even on distant servers.

### Verdict on server availability

If raw server count matters to you, NordVPN has the edge. If you prioritize a curated, high-performance network, ExpressVPN holds its own despite fewer total servers.

---

## Connection Speed and Performance

### NordVPN speed tests

NordVPN's NordLynx protocol (built around WireGuard) delivers excellent download speeds. In real-world testing, speed retention is consistently high, making it suitable for 4K streaming, large downloads, and gaming.

### ExpressVPN speed tests

ExpressVPN's Lightway protocol is also very fast, often matching or slightly exceeding NordVPN on some server locations. Both providers perform well enough that most users won't notice a difference during everyday browsing or streaming.

### Which is faster

In head-to-head comparisons, the two are very close. Protocol choice and server distance usually matter more than the brand itself.

---

## Streaming and Geo-Unblocking

Both VPNs reliably unblock major streaming platforms including Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, and BBC iPlayer. NordVPN has a slight advantage in accessing more regional libraries due to its larger server count. ExpressVPN also performs well but may occasionally require switching servers for certain platforms.

If streaming is your primary use case, NordVPN gives you more fallback options, but ExpressVPN remains a solid choice for consistent access to the most popular services.

---

## Security and Privacy Features

### NordVPN security tools

NordVPN offers Double VPN (multi-hop routing), Threat Protection (blocks ads, trackers, and malware), Dark Web Monitor, and Meshnet for secure device linking. The no-logs policy has been independently audited multiple times.

### ExpressVPN security tools

ExpressVPN provides a strong kill switch, split tunneling, and its own Lightway protocol with built-in leak protection. The company's no-logs policy has also undergone independent audits, and it operates a bug bounty program.

### Privacy policies compared

Both companies are based outside Five Eyes intelligence-sharing alliances and maintain verified no-logs policies. Neither stores browsing activity or connection timestamps, so your privacy is well protected with either choice.

---

## Device Support and Apps

Both VPNs support Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and browser extensions. NordVPN allows more simultaneous device connections, which is ideal for households with many devices. ExpressVPN's limit is more restrictive but still sufficient for most individual users.

Router support is available from both, though ExpressVPN offers a dedicated router app that simplifies setup.

---

## Customer Support Experience

ExpressVPN is known for responsive 24/7 live chat and fast email support. NordVPN also provides round-the-clock chat support and an extensive knowledge base. Both companies maintain helpful setup guides and troubleshooting articles.

In terms of response quality, ExpressVPN's support team is often praised for being slightly more knowledgeable with technical issues, while NordVPN's support is efficient and reliable for common questions.

---

## Final Recommendation

NordVPN is the better pick for most people due to its lower long-term pricing, higher connection limits, and extra security tools like Threat Protection and Meshnet. ExpressVPN is ideal if you want a simple, premium VPN with excellent speed and don't mind paying a bit more for a streamlined experience.

Both are trustworthy and capable — your decision should come down to budget, desired features, and how many devices you need to protect.

---

## FAQ

**Is NordVPN cheaper than ExpressVPN?**
Yes, NordVPN is generally more affordable, especially on long-term plans. ExpressVPN's single plan costs more per month, though both offer discounts for annual commitments.

**Which VPN is better for streaming?**
NordVPN has a slight edge due to its larger server network, but ExpressVPN also reliably unblocks most major streaming platforms.

**Are both VPNs safe to use?**
Absolutely. Both NordVPN and ExpressVPN have independently audited no-logs policies, strong encryption, and operate under privacy-friendly jurisdictions.
